description: A full data table with search, sorting, row selection and paging. Try searching "Rancabali" or clicking the Pengunjung column title.
installation: Data Table is not a separate component but a pattern combining the Table component with the @tanstack/react-table v8 library.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.columns: Define the columns (ColumnDef): which data to show and how it looks.
howItWorks.table: Create the table with useReactTable(): data, columns and the features you want (sorting, filtering, paging).
howItWorks.render: Render it with the Table components: TableHeader from getHeaderGroups(), TableBody from getRowModel().

docs: Full TanStack Table documentation is at tanstack.com/table/v8.
